function.name: copy_sandbox_objects
function.description: Copy selected object types from the current site into an existing sandbox site.

siteName.description: Name suffix of the target sandbox site.

objectTypes.description: Object types to copy from the current site. Available values: Layout, View, Style, Script, Image, File, Menu, HtmlBlock, Label, Form, ContentFolder, ContentType, ContentCategory, TextContent, Code, OpenApi, Page.
